reviews.t: Excellent formula for neck, forehead, and eyes!
reviews.x: I love the cooling feeling from this thick gel.  It has a unique push down applicator that you can simply swipe off the amount you dispense to put it on your forehead, under your chin, around your neck or around your eyes.  As it dries and sinks into your skin, it makes it feel a bit tighter. There is also a moisturizing feel to it as well.  I realize that this sounds contradictory: moisturizing, plus tightening but it does work. I find that the results last, for me, about 3-4 hours.  This is no

reviews.t: Better than Rodan and Fields
reviews.x: I like this eye gel. I like that it doesn't burn my eyes, it is cooling. I use it all over my face and neck. It is hard to say what it does because no cream is going to give you plastic surgery results. But I can say I like this better than that over priced Rodan and Fields stuff. The photos the consultants post on Facebook promise better than plastic surgery results, when I could see no difference after using their eye cream for four months. So save your money and use this stuff instead.

reviews.t: For Perfect Eyes!
reviews.x: This eye gel is the greatest! I have noticed a difference in only a few weeks! And the great thing about it is you can put it on under your make-up and it doesn't leave you with a smeary mess later! Everything stays in place and the skin around your eyes looks hydrated and soft--that is a rare combination! I love this product, and I have tried dozens of different types and brands in the past--this one will stay a staple in my beauty bag!

reviews.t: Great Product! Majestic Pure cosmeceuticals Eye Gel has been ...
reviews.x: Great Product! Majestic Pure cosmeceuticals Eye Gel has been a wonderful addition to my morning and evening routine. I have seen significant improvement with the lighting of my dark circles under my eyes, I have also noticed that there is less puffiness as well. The product has an easy to use pump where the gel doesn’t spill or go all over the place. It is easy to use smells great and makes my skin feel soft. Definitely recommend!

reviews.t: Pump doesn't work
reviews.x: Is there some magic involved in getting the pump to work?  I have tried repeatedly without success to get the gel to come out of the top as it's supposed to.  I took the lid off and dug some out so I could try it, and the gel itself is fine.  But why won't the pump work as advertised?  If anyone else has had this problem and solved it, I would appreciate a comment to my review.

reviews.t: No complaints, nice tingle feeling around my eyes
reviews.x: Have been using this product for one week, i apply just around my eyes and it seems to be a good moisturizer. I don't see any improvement at this time and know it could take months to reap the rewards, but i think it does look a little smoother, or maybe because i never use anything around my eyes.  So, if you currently use nothing around your eyes, this product can only help.

reviews.t: It Works
reviews.x: I have used the product for a week and I noticed my eye puffiness go away. My dark circles diminish and I feel a tingle to my skin similar to when you exfoliate. I also Love the easy push down dispenser.

claims.text: Many reviewers report visible results, such as reduced under-eye creases, diminished bags, and less discoloration.
Reviewers frequently describe a tightening effect on the skin.
Several customers are repeat buyers who would purchase again and recommend it.
Some reviewers note it is not a miracle product but still works well.
A few reviewers praise the pump dispenser and lightweight, non-drying feel.
